name: 79-abbreviation-letters
description: An abbreviation matches case-insensitively by the fold of each letter (SPEC §4). So 'U.ſ.' with a long s (U+017F) is the abbreviation 'u.s.', and it joins as 'U.S.' does: 'up to' reaches $60 and $70 (spec 0.10, #350, #356).
document: Fees are up to the U.ſ. code cap of $60. Fees are up to the U.S. code cap of $70.
